rule: The shortest prefix, starting at slot 0, of the recorded dev60 slot order that contains all six classes (IND28, M16-L, M16-R, S8, white_box, ycb_box). The identities below are pinned; never recompute them on a reordered or regenerated slot list.

protocol: Evidence: unchanged v0.3 (perception/evidence_v03.py --align image, ECC image registration) and, from the same pass, the v0.2.1 + image-alignment ablation (v021_image). L1-reference jobs (jobs_refL1.json); L1 and L2 queries reported separately.

Thresholds: the existing shelf thresholds only; nothing is calibrated, selected or retuned on this subset. v03_image: the shelf_dev_v3 select-v4 candidate below. v021_image: shelf calibration was infeasible, so it has no shelf thresholds and is reported at the illustrative setting only.
Simulator true alignment (true_alignment.json, sim.true_align_evidence) is evaluation only: it measures registration error and is never an evidence or policy input.

All 11 arrangements are reported, including failures, registration refusals and render problems. No arrangement is substituted, dropped or added on the basis of results. The design cases TDES0-3 are not part of this set.
The researcher reviews this diagnostic before the full 60-arrangement tabletop render.
